summary: The platform gateway uses the AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR to put controller, hub, Event-Driven Ansible and opt-in Lightspeed behind one UI; it needs the AAP Operator 2.6 in the namespace, and all components it deploys default to 2.6.
questions: What is the platform gateway on OpenShift?
Is Lightspeed enabled by default on AAP Operator?
What do I need before deploying the platform gateway?
